name: dumbbell 6 ways raise
description: A series of six dumbbell raises in different directions. It thoroughly trains the shoulders.
instructions: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides and brace your trunk.
Raise both arms out to shoulder height, then move them forward at the same height.
Lift the dumbbells overhead, lower them back to shoulder height in front, and open the arms out to the sides.
Lower the dumbbells to your sides. These six controlled phases complete one repetition.
